# SEO-614: Render body text at a readable size without zoom

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Domain | `mobile` |

| Evidence tier | `A` |
| Confidence | `HIGH` |

## Statement

Body text is legible at the default zoom level on a narrow viewport, text scales when the reader increases it up to the published factor without content being lost, and the viewport declaration does not disable scaling.

## Rationale

Text small enough to require zooming means every reader pinches before reading, and a viewport declaration that forbids scaling removes their ability to do so at all.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Remove any maximum-scale or user-scalable restriction from the viewport declaration, set body text from a relative unit so it responds to the reader's preference, and check the layout still holds at the published scale factor.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Inspect the viewport declaration for scaling restrictions and re-render each route at the published zoom factor, checking for clipped or overlapping content.
- Evidence: `RENDERED_HTML`, `BROWSER`, `ACCESSIBILITY_SCAN`
- Automated check: none.

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_SEARCH`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: none recorded.
